findings: The adapter must target the exact stager-produced selected-retention candidate, not the authenticated held input whose Mailbox lacks the candidate guards.
Mode-3 stage-3/commit-1/wake-Some first returns -11 and releases only after deterministic recovery beyond two seconds; wake-None bypasses send.
Address observations must be ledger deltas after construction/preparation, which already call address.
The -71/-125 cancel expectation is pre-release only; a committed release makes retention_released true and cannot be rolled back.
A raw NonNull constructor alone does not prove retained ownership, safe unfinished Drop or deterministic second-CAS failure.
